messages:
elaine: Quick planning note 1 running a few 50-min enablement drop-ins next week for three accounts with onboarding lag. Want to keep them practical: infra pre-check, migration demo, and a short action list. Proposed slots: Mon 10:00 PT, Wed 14:30 PT, Fri 09:00 PT.

mohit: I can run Mon 10:00 PT. will focus on model pin + quant tradeoffs.

tara: Wed 14:30 PT works for me. prefer 30m demo + 20m triage.

ben: I9ll take Fri 09:00 PT and own post-session actions. happy to capture adoption commitments.

elaine: Draft agenda: 1) 5m intros & ok-to-outcomes 2) 12m infra pre-check (KMS, VPC routes) 3) 18m migration/demo (pin, batch settings, cache) 4) 5m runbook highlights 5) 10m actions + quick feedback.

mohit: Pre-read: 1-pager with sample batch config + token estimate. I'll drop it in the invite. Also adding a tiny pre-check curl they can run 5m before start.

tara: I'll add a rollback slide and help triage notes during Q&A. can we have someone own feedback form? simple 4-question survey.

ben: I can build the feedback (Google form) and set a 24h reminder. will auto-flag responses with score <=3 as #renewal-risk and ping AM.

ops-bot: calendar: invites created for 2026-07-06T10:00:00-07:00, 2026-07-08T14:30:00-07:00, 2026-07-10T09:00:00-07:00. Notes doc: https://docs.internal/enable/dropins/jul.

elaine: Final owners: Mon 10 = Mohit (SE) + Elaine (CS); Wed 14:30 = Tara (SE) + Elaine (CS); Fri 09 = Ben (SE) + Elaine (CS). Feedback owner: Ben. Action summaries due within 24h. I'll push invites and the pre-read today. :white_check_mark:
